channel.title: Coffee and Cozy | OuqCreations
channel.description: Coffee and Cozy: cute, funny character stickers, shirts, mugs and gifts by OuqCreations.

item.title: Cute Ghost Pottery Centered the Clay Not Myself
item.description: A little ghost proudly holds a slightly wobbly handmade clay bowl, admitting it managed to center the clay but not itself. A funny gift for potters, ceramicists and anyone in a pottery class. Available on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Cute Ghost Spooky Until My First Morning Coffee
item.description: A little ghost hugs a steaming coffee mug, only spooky until that first morning sip. A funny gift for coffee lovers and anyone who isn't a morning person. Find it on stickers, mugs and hoodies. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Cute Coffee Bat Nocturnal but Make It Caffeinated
item.description: A tiny round bat hugs a coffee mug with both wings, because even creatures of the night need their caffeine. A funny gift for night owls and coffee lovers, on stickers, mugs and hoodies. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
